fields.name: classes
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Variant A: the big word on a spotlight with the car in front, text centred below. Variant B: the image on the left, the text beside it.

options.name: Variant A – Reserved (spotlight, word and car)
Variant B – All set (image beside the text)

fields.name: displayWord
fields.label: Background word
fields.description: Variant A: the large word behind the car, e.g. RESERVED (not used by Variant B).

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Status heading
fields.description: E.g. YOU’RE IN, {firstName}. Values of the reservation (from the form, or the page address) fill {firstName}, {lastName}, {email}, {mobile}, {city}; {name|fallback} shows the fallback when there is none, otherwise the value and its comma are left out.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: E.g. We’ll message you when allocation opens. Your receipt is on its way to {email|your inbox}. Variant A shows each sentence on its own line. Values as in the heading.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Variant A: the car, cut out on a transparent background, in front of the word. Variant B: the photo on the left.

fields.name: background
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Variant A: fills the block behind the word and the car (decorative; not used by Variant B).

fields.name: ctaLink
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: Optional: a button under the description (none in the designs).
